text: The tester shall be able to read the VIN (DID 0xF190) in any diagnostic session.
The tester shall be able to read the ECU part number (DID 0xF187) and serial number (DID 0xF18C) in any session.
The tester shall be able to switch the BCM into extended diagnostic session (0x03) and back to default session (0x01).
The tester shall be able to switch the BCM into programming session (0x02) only when required preconditions are met.
Writing the interior lighting brightness DID (0x0100) shall require extended session and security level 0x01.
Writing the ambient lighting color index DID (0x0101) shall require extended session and security level 0x01.
The wiper sensitivity level (DID 0x0130) shall only accept values between 1 and 5 inclusive.
The interior lighting brightness (DID 0x0100) shall only accept values between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The factory reset flag (DID 0x0150) shall only be writable in programming session with security level 0x03, and only while the vehicle is stationary.
SecurityAccess level 0x01 shall lock out further attempts for 10 seconds after 3 consecutive invalid keys.
The lighting self-test routine (0x0201) shall not accept a stop or requestResults subfunction before start has been sent.
The door actuator calibration routine (0x0202) shall only run while the vehicle is stationary.
ECUReset shall support hard reset (0x01) and soft reset (0x03) subfunctions only.
TesterPresent shall be accepted in every diagnostic session to keep the S3 session timer from expiring.
